Episode 164. The Land of the Evil Spirit (7)
Runcandel's 4th Secret Technique, Black Cross.
Rosa unfolded that sword as soon as the Meteor Shower broke.
The blades of frenzy drawn in a cross were emitting a black sword aura.
Centered around the intersection, the sword aura of the Black Cross was poured onto Talaris, drawing a circle.
Rosa is not a pure-blooded Runcandel.
However, perhaps due to accepting chaos, she perfectly implemented her ultimate and secret techniques without a blessed body, and her power was so strong that it reminded people of Ciron, not Rosa.
In front of numerous sword auras of the Black Cross, Talaris and Mort had no way to avoid them.
Originally, Jin should have staked his and Kaio's lives to get past Rosa and delve into it.
Even so, it was uncertain whether the weary bodies of the two could withstand Rosa's secret technique.
They might not only fail to save Talaris, but also all face death.
If Murakan hadn't appeared now, it probably would have been so with a high probability.
At the moment when the Black Cross was about to engulf Talaris and Mort,
As if a black mountain had risen out of nowhere, Murakan's enormous body landed behind Talaris and Mort.
At a glance, his body was much larger than Jin remembered.
The pair of black wings spread out like a wall to block the Black Cross, so large they even hid Mort.
The blades drawn from the frenzy kept causing fissures in the wings without rest.
The wings seemed to be torn apart in an instant, but it was just an illusion caused by fluctuating soul energy.
["Long time no see, Bigungju. How did you become so weak? Mr. Mort seems to be badly hurt as well."]
Talaris raising her head.
At the relief given by Murakan's darkness, she smiled slightly.
Just a moment ago, she was on the verge of death, but now she even felt as if being inside this dark and huge dragon was the safest place in the world.
"You showed up at the perfect moment. How did you become so powerful, Black Dragon bro?"
["I've just regained a bit more of what I lost. And thanks to that, it seems that neither the kiddo nor I will lose you today."]
"Hehe, I might fall for you."
The power he had during the last battle fought with his companions, during the Swords' Emperor City War, the power he had in his past.
Not just Jin, but also Talaris, who could not feel the soul energy as sensitively, could recognize it at a glance.
The power Murakan currently has is quite close to his prime.
Finally, Jin's soul energy, having reached the 10-star level, and the crises he'd been through on behalf of Solderet were restoring his old power.
Murakan raised his wings again.
Talaris and Mort were unharmed by the Black Cross, and Rosa's expression twisted.
["The old guardian dragon of the family... I didn't feel your presence at all."]
This was why Rosa was angry.
She was feeling all the battles taking place in the Garden of Swords and the entire Calon region as if they were her own body.
However, she didn't notice Murakan's appearance at all. This meant that Murakan did not approach from outside the Garden of Swords, but suddenly appeared from within.
["Your enlightenment is still lacking, Rosa Runcandel."]
Rosa turned around and looked at Jin.
["You and your companions are lucky, youngest. At moments like now, when you are in a crisis, someone always comes to rescue you."]
Rosa doesn't know all the stories of Jin and his companions.
But she did know that at every moment of crisis, they had come through difficulties with the help of someone, or each other.
Such an event had never once happened in her Runcandel.
Only the hope that never returned no matter how long she waited was there. Rosa did not hide the miserable feelings that stemmed from that fact.
["I will... break that chain."]
The Blades of Chaos stopped in mid-air started to whirl again. The blades, as if filled with Rosa's anger, drove the party more fiercely than before.
At the same time, part of Murakan's body turned into soul energy and grabbed Talaris and Mort. He moved quickly like a hawk and freely like a ghost, instantly approaching Jin's side.
Rosa scattered sword auras all around her from her place. A part of Murakan's body that had turned into smoke was swept away, but it didn't seem to significantly affect him.
Murakan had come, but the battlefield was still dominated by Rosa.
Jin, Talaris, Kaio. None of the three were in a state to fight properly.
And that wasn't all.
Jin, without having time to exchange greetings with Murakan at their reunion, was reading his urgent feelings.
"Surely you're not in a state where you can't fight properly either?"
["That's not it, but there's not enough time."]
After the Swords' Emperor City War ended, Murakan had been performing Solderet's proxy in place of Misha.
What exactly this entails, even Misha, who had been managing Solderet's duties before, didn't know for certain.
Because it's beyond mortal cognition, the roles of Misha and Murakan are simply to maintain their 'state of existence' in Solderet's domain on his behalf.
The release of this maintenance becomes a great threat to the world.
In particular, Murakan was not as skilled as Misha, and therefore, the time he could leave his place was shorter.
Especially in a state of using such great power.
The reason why Rosa could not perceive Murakan's energy was for this reason. Murakan had manifested here without any physical movement from the realm of the gods.
There was no time to explain in detail.
[So we need to escape quickly. Anyway, you can't continue to fight with your current body condition.]
In addition, there was the problem of the seal of Elona Zipfel.
As Talaris' internal injury worsened, the seal area that Misha had to bear also increased. From the moment Rosa hit him, Talaris had been constantly worried about the seal.
Jin nodded his head.
What was somewhat fortunate was that.
To Murakan, it was the fact that Rosa's power also had no restrictions.
[Don't ignore me too much, Murakan. Do you think you can escape?]
[Don't bluff, Rosa Runcandel. It's not just this side that doesn't have room, I can see a little bit of the realm that mortals can't see now.]
[You're talking big about having no answer but to run......]
Swish-!
Rushing Rosa cut Murakan's just spewed breath in half.
The spirit spines jumping up from all around blocked her, but her frenzy stopped after colliding with Bradamante.
"I can feel your rage."
Rosa continued to attack again, but Murakan's spirit and Kaio's arrows restricted her movement.
While the frenzy blocked Kaio's attack, the spirit spine brushed Rosa's forehead.
About half a finger, a horn on her forehead broke and black blood splattered.
Until now, the chaos that Rosa emitted showed a stable form like a spirit.
However, her soul has been chaotic since her black cross was blocked by Murakan. The color and power changed inconsistently.
'Surely, as Murakan said, there were restrictions on this infinite power. It doesn't seem to be because the horn was hurt. Is there a lack of intermediaries? Or... there might be some mental reason.'
Unlike Ron or Samalion before they resisted fate, there is a completely remaining reason.
He thought that might be the key. Rosa herself said, 'I haven't yet succumbed to chaos,' came to mind.
Anyway, what's important now is to escape. Even though the soul became unstable, it had no effect on the transcendental level she possessed.
Swoosh-!
Rosa's black sword was stubbornly aiming at Talaris. Every time the sword's spirit and the spirit collided, the sky opened and closed in its entirety.
Murakan tried hard to prevent the shock from being transmitted to Talaris. He had to worry about Talaris' life, Elona's seal, and even the time limit, so his insides burned every second.
The battle was stuck.
That meant that Jin's party was still at a disadvantage.
Even if Rosa has a limitation, surely Murakan's forced return will be faster.
“The escape point is a forest about 150 miles away, Black Dragon brother. Can you break through there? There's a space-jump spaceship."
Talaris pointed to the location where the Red Owl was hidden with his finger.
["It'll be a close call. Which way is it?"]
If he amplifies his spirit energy for the breakthrough, the forced return will speed up.
Murakan did not hesitate to raise his energy. It was definitely better than continuing the stagnant battle. Even if his appearance ends before reaching the escape point.
"I'll buy us some time, Black Dragon Murakan. Escape with the Jin brothers."
The moment Kaio said that.
Suddenly, a voice came from the sky.
[Murakan! I'll cover you!]
It was Orgal's voice. Above them was the first ship of Kinzelo, Grenil, loaded with a tremendous thunderstorm.
The other ships were still far away. Reading the situation, Orgal opened a dimensional gate and moved to the battlefield where they were.
Of course, the spirit energy affected his teleportation ability. However, since all the spirit energy of Calon was focused on Rosa, the restriction was relatively lighter than before.
Murakan recognized him as Orgal even without Jin explaining.
A lightning bolt poured into a single point struck Rosa.
At that moment, Murakan took Jin and Kaio on his back and flew into the sky. Another blade energy of Rosa pierced through the thunderstorm of Grenil and followed him.
It was the fifth secret technique, the light speed stab. The sword energy left a large wound on Murakan's tail, back, and left wing, but he moved forward without care.
"Murakan, are you alright!"
[Of course I am, just a little bit sore. But it's cheap considering it's the cost of saving you and the bow owner.]
Thanks to Grenil, he had a bit of time since he didn't have to amplify his power.
However, there was one factor that Murakan failed to calculate.
The fact that Ram, the huge black ship of Runcandel, was approaching. And in the place where Grenil's lightning disappeared, Rosa's figure was no longer visible.
She stood at the forefront of Ram, watching the direction Murakan was heading. Ram and she were as if they were one body.
Ram reloaded the cannon at an incomparable speed to the beginning. The spirit energy that darkened the sky was becoming even more unstable.
"Miss Rosa, how about stopping here?"
At the prophet's question, Rosa burst out laughing.
[Wasn't it always your wish for my mind to collapse?]
"Honestly, it's a bit dangerous now."
Rosa silently accelerated the amplification of chaos, and Ilina watched her side profile with anxious eyes.
